events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A public CHANEL fragrance experience for COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU, with personalized fragrance discovery and the wider COCO MADEMOISELLE beauty collection onsite.
events.what_is_free: Free public entry and fragrance discovery experience; products are available to purchase onsite.
events.caveats: CHANEL states appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore optional rather than required for public access. Capacity may still affect immediate entry.
events.practical_notes: The second public run is September 18–20 at 873 Washington Street: Friday noon–7 PM; Saturday and Sunday 10 AM–7 PM. Walk-ins are encouraged; appointments are optional and limited.

events.address: The Brant Foundation, 421 East 6th Street, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: An immersive Cj Hendry and Sulwhasoo installation inspired by the hidden garden at Sulwhasoo's Seoul flagship, built as an all-white participatory environment visitors can draw and write on.
events.what_is_free: Open public admission to the interactive Secret Garden installation.
events.caveats: Sulwhasoo and Cj Hendry's official pages corroborate the collaboration and September 18–20 New York run; current public event listings specify 10 AM–6 PM and open-to-public access. No required ticket or RSVP was found in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at The Brant Foundation, 421 E 6th St. Current evidence supports walk-in public access. Cj Hendry installations can draw lines, so capacity/queueing may affect immediate entry.
